slot_scores.name: minimize_total_production_and_storage_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (production cost plus storage cost) over the four weeks, subject to meeting all demand and respecting weekly production capacities?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total production plus storage cost, fully covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: demand_must_be_met_each_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (production cost plus storage cost) over the four weeks, subject to meeting all demand and respecting weekly production capacities?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent mentioned meeting all demand as part of the objective confirmation, but did not explicitly ask whether demand must be fully met each week or whether backorders/unmet demand are allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: All weekly demand must be fully met, with no backorders or unmet demand allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm whether demand satisfaction is mandatory each week or whether backorders/unmet demand are permitted; it treated full demand satisfaction as required in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 demand-satisfaction obligation was not explicitly clarified before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the core objective and several modeling details, but only partially addressed the demand-satisfaction obligation and stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
